<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-06-2509-18-11" status="unreviewed"> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3925">gtum ston</rs> gyis lcags mo bya nas chu pho spre'u'i bar snar thang dang nye ba'i gnas ci rigs su bzhugs te thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe 'khor kha cig kyang 'dus pas chu mo bya la <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">snar thang</rs> btab | 
         lo bcu bzhi bzhugs nas de rting la stod du thegs | nyid kyi gdan sar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3924">rdo ston shes rab grags</rs> bskos nas des gdan sa lo nyi shu mdzad | 
        de rjes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3974">zhang btsun rdo rje 'od</rs> kyis lo brgyad | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3880">gro ston bdud rtsi grags</rs> kyis lo sum cu rtsa dgu | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3890">zhang ston chos kyi bla ma</rs>s lo bcu | 
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3976">sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs</rs> kyis lo bcu | 
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">mchims nam mkha' grags</rs> kyis lo sum cu rtsa drug <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4052">skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims</rs> kyis lo bco lnga | 
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6520">nyi ma rgyal mtshan</rs> gyis lo bdun | 
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6519">ze'u ba brtson 'grus grags pa</rs>s lo bcu gnyis | 
         khong gi gcung po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4065">grags pa shes rab pa</rs>s lo bcu gnyis | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4007">mkhan chen blo bzang grags pa</rs>s lo bzhi bcu | 
         
         'di yan [345]du lo nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gsum song | de rting shing mo yos la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhan chen kun rgyal ba</rs> bskos | shing yos de nas me mo bya'i bar lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7539">mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa</rs> dang | de'i dbon po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8252">mkhan chen rin po che grub pa shes rab pa</rs>s gdan sa bskyangs pa yin | </seg></TEI>
